question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this durable review-telemetry and dashboard-health contract as the compatibility foundation before the per-item shard rollout in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674?
rationale: The patch defines operational health semantics, persistent record identity, retention, and API behavior that later automation will depend on; tests alone cannot determine whether those are the intended long-term product and operator contract.

options.title: Approve after runtime proof
options.body: Keep the additive contract, require redacted isolated Worker/Durable Object evidence for the key lifecycle paths, then merge it ahead of the dependent rollout.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Ask for a reduced or revised telemetry/health API contract before accepting it as the dependency for later queue protocol work.

options.title: Defer with the shard rollout
options.body: Pause this foundation until the maintainer-approved item-shard implementation can establish the final telemetry identities and health semantics together.

recommendation.title: Approve after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Keep the additive contract, require redacted isolated Worker/Durable Object evidence for the key lifecycle paths, then merge it ahead of the dependent rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked foundation and dependent rollout proposal and can explain the intended compatibility boundary.
